entries.note: The empty container leaves the terminal for the shipper to load it; the cargo is not yet with Pasha Hawaii.
The empty container leaves the terminal for the shipper, as Oakland words it.
The loaded container enters the terminal at the port of loading.
The loaded container leaves the terminal for the consignee.
The empty container comes back to the terminal once the consignee unloaded it. Without a bill and before the container left full, it is an unused one, without a stage.
An empty container loaded to reposition it after its return; it belongs to no shipment.
An empty container discharged after its repositioning voyage; it belongs to no shipment.
An empty container loaded on the inter-island barge, coming back from a neighbor island; the stage stays that of the move before.
The inter-island barge leaves with the container; the stage stays that of the move before.
The inter-island barge arrives with the container; the stage stays that of the move before.
An empty container taken off the inter-island barge; the stage stays that of the move before.
An empty container moved from the barge's yard toward the terminal; the stage stays that of the move before.
